prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in injuries to our client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured is represented by counsel or has been asked to provide a statement, we ask that you let us know so that we can coordinate any necessary contact.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the liability policy issued to your insured, including a declarations page, and confirm the bodily injury and property damage limits available under that policy, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle data, surveillance or parking lot video, and any other materials in your possession or in the possession of your insured. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response.
